Competency in molecular biology (DNA handling, cloning, qPCR)
Prior experience working independently to devise clearly written experimental plans, conducting experiments following those plans, and performing solid data analysis with well-reasoned conclusions
Demonstrated capability in planning, executing, troubleshooting, and analyzing experiments
Strong oral and written communication skills
Reliable team player who communicates clearly and regularly with colleagues
Attention to detail and good organizational skills, with the ability to manage several assignments at once
Ability to learn advanced lab techniques and concepts
Flexible and able to move quickly in new directions

Ph.D. In immunology with emphasis on immuno-oncology
MRNA display or other display techniques
Experience giving clear and engaging scientific presentations to colleagues and stakeholders
Proficiency in PowerPoint, Excel, flow cytometry data analysis, and DOE

Comfort with PowerPoint, Excel, and basic data analysis.

Exposure to flow cytometry data analysis and design of experiments (DOE).

It is well suited for someone with skills in flow cytometry, protein technologies, molecular biology, and display techniques. The lab scientist will work with the team on the development of immuno-oncology assays. Other duties may be assigned as needed.
cond_0567.responsibilities:
Collaborate with team members to develop and perform research involving various techniques, with primary emphasis on flow cytometry, T cell cultures, and T cell-based functional assays.
Coordinate with colleagues to carry out multi-step tasks.
Work alongside the team to troubleshoot processes, instrumentation, and equipment.
Contribute to experiments that generate new or update existing SOPs.
Document laboratory experiments and processes, sharing findings with the team.
Help ensure scientific and technical tasks are completed on schedule by managing time effectively.
cond_0567.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Graduate degree (MS/Ph.D.) in Immunology, Biological Sciences, Pharmacology, or related discipline
Competency in molecular biology (DNA handling, cloning, qPCR)
Experience in protein engineering and conjugation techniques
Hands-on experience with eukaryote cell and bacteria culture
Extensive expertise in flow cytometry with a proven track record
Prior experience working independently to devise clearly written experimental plans, conducting experiments, and performing solid data analysis with well-reasoned conclusions
Demonstrated capability in planning, executing, troubleshooting, and analyzing experiments
Strong oral and written communication skills
Reliable team player with good organizational skills and ability to multitask
Preferred Requirements
Ph.D. In immunology with emphasis on immuno-oncology, or M.S. With equivalent industry experience
MRNA display or other display techniques
Experience giving clear scientific presentations
Proficiency in PowerPoint, Excel, flow cytometry data analysis, and DOE
Flexibility to move into new directions or areas as needed
Self-starter who is productive and efficient with attention to detail
